    log_prob = feature_cache["log_prob"]  # (B,K)
    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    idxs = torch.arange(K, device=device)
    winner_idx = idxs.repeat_interleave(K)  # (K*K,)
    loser_idx = idxs.repeat(K)              # (K*K,)
    mask = winner_idx != loser_idx          # exclude self-pairs
    winner_idx = winner_idx[mask]            # (num_pairs,)
    loser_idx = loser_idx[mask]              # (num_pairs,)

    loser_idx = loser_idx.repeat(B)    # (B*num_pairs,)

    obj_w_raw = objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    obj_l_raw = objective[b_idx, loser_idx]

    # Determine true winner and loser per pair by objective (lower is better)
    winner_mask = obj_w_raw <= obj_l_raw

    # Swap indices where winner_idx is actually loser
    true_winner_idx = torch.where(winner_mask, winner_idx, loser_idx)
    true_loser_idx = torch.where(winner_mask, loser_idx, winner_idx)

    logp_w = log_prob[b_idx, true_winner_idx]
    logp_l = log_prob[b_idx, true_loser_idx]

    # Return PrefBatch with correct semantics and weights

    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # Compute pairwise advantage difference
    gap = objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None]
    # Apply gap threshold to select pairs with significant advantage
    thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.5))
    mask = gap > thr
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    max_band = int(extra.get('rank_band_width', 5))
    # Compute ranks ascending (lower objective is better)

    # Construct pairwise rank distance matrix

    mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= max_band)
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Compute weights inversely proportional to rank gap, normalized to [0,1]
    rank_gaps = rank_diff[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx].float()
    weights = (max_band + 1 - rank_gaps) / max_band  # larger gap lower weight
    # Normalize weights to max 1.0 (already <=1)
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_sparse', 'rank_band_width': max_band})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    band_width = int(extra.get('band_width', 5))
    exp_cap = float(extra.get('exp_cap', 10.0))

    B, N = objective.shape
    # Compute ranks per batch (argsort twice)
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # shape (B, N)

    # For each item, find candidates within rank band [rank - band_width, rank + band_width]
    # We'll create pairs (winner, loser) where winner objective < loser objective (lower is better)

    # Expand ranks for pairwise comparison
    ranks_exp_w = ranks.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    ranks_exp_l = ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)

    # Rank difference mask: within band_width and not self-pair
    rank_diff = ranks_exp_l - ranks_exp_w  # (B, N, N)
    band_mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= band_width)  # only pairs where loser rank is within band above winner rank

    # Disagreement: objective difference sign mismatches log_prob ordering
    # Compute objective difference and log_prob difference
    obj_diff = objective.unsqueeze(2) - objective.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, N, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache.get('log_prob', None)
    if log_prob is None:
        # fallback: no weighting
        log_prob_diff = obj_diff  # dummy
    else:
        log_prob_diff = log_prob.unsqueeze(2) - log_prob.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, N, N)

    # We want pairs where sign(obj_diff) != sign(log_prob_diff) to emphasize disagreement
    sign_obj = obj_diff > 0
    sign_lp = log_prob_diff > 0
    disagreement_mask = sign_obj != sign_lp

    # Combine band and disagreement masks
    mask = band_mask & disagreement_mask

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Compute exponential weights capped at exp_cap based on absolute objective difference
    abs_diff = obj_diff[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx].abs()
    weights = torch.exp(abs_diff)
    weights = torch.clamp(weights, max=exp_cap)

    # Limit to max_pairs by top weights
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(weights, max_pairs, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        weights = topk_vals

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_disagreement_010', 'band_width': band_width, 'exp_cap': exp_cap, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    batch_size, n = objective.shape

    # Compute ranks per batch by sorting objectives ascending (lower is better)
    sorted_obj, sorted_idx = objective.sort(dim=1)  # ascending
    ranks = torch.zeros_like(sorted_idx)
    ranks.scatter_(1, sorted_idx, torch.arange(n, device=objective.device).view(1, -1).expand(batch_size, n))

    band_width = int(extra.get('rank_band_width', 3))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))

    # For each item, find candidates within rank band
    # We create pairwise rank differences: shape (B, N, N)
    ranks_i = ranks.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    ranks_j = ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)
    rank_diff = torch.abs(ranks_i - ranks_j)  # (B, N, N)

    # Mask pairs within band width and where i != j
    band_mask = (rank_diff <= band_width) & (ranks_i != ranks_j)

    # Further mask winners with strictly better (lower) objective
    obj_i = objective.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    obj_j = objective.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)
    winner_mask = obj_i < obj_j

    mask = band_mask & winner_mask

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Compute gap weights capped to [0, 1]
    gap = (obj_j - obj_i)[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]
    gap_capped = gap.clamp(max=1.0)

    weight = gap_capped

    # Limit number of pairs by highest gap weights
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(weight, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        weight = weight[topk_idx]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_sparse', 'band_width': band_width, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

ir.intuition: Pairs sparse anchors with a rank band neighborhood, applies disagreement filtering and tie-zone constraint to exclude near ties, using uniform weighting to emphasize pair diversity without bias.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    band_width = int(extra.get('band_width', 4))
    tie_zone_eps = float(extra.get('tie_zone_eps', 1e-3))

    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # (B, N)

    anchor_mask = (ranks % (band_width + 2)) == 0  # sparse anchors
    b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx = anchor_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if anchor_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx, anchor_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'rankband_disagreement_sparse_tiezone_uniformweight'})

    anchor_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)

    candidate_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)

    rank_diff = candidate_ranks - anchor_ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)

    band_mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= band_width)

    obj_diff = candidate_obj - anchor_obj.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    logp_diff = candidate_logp - anchor_logp.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    sign_obj = obj_diff > 0
    sign_lp = logp_diff > 0
    disagreement_mask = sign_obj != sign_lp

    adv_gap = obj_diff.abs()
    tie_mask = adv_gap >= tie_zone_eps

    mask = band_mask & disagreement_mask & tie_mask

    b_idx_pairs, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx_pairs]
    b_idx = b_idx_anchors[b_idx_pairs]

    # uniform weights
    weights = None

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'rankband_disagreement_sparse_tiezone_uniformweight', 'band_width': band_width, 'tie_zone_eps': tie_zone_eps})
